name: g42_roost_ground_order
purpose: Roost and the Ground move of the same turn. Dragonite is damaged only by the Sandstorm of Tyranitar (no damaging move, so no KO): turn 1 Garchomp (faster) and Steelix Stomping Tantrum Dragonite (immune, the Flying type), Dragonite Stomping Tantrums Garchomp. Turn 2: Garchomp (faster) Tantrums before Dragonite Roosts, so the Flying type still makes it immune; Steelix (slower) Tantrums after the Roost and hits (doubled: its turn-1 result was an immunity, FALSE). Turn 3: the Flying type is back (the Roost bit ends in the residual of turn 2): Garchomp and Steelix are immune. Turn 4: a second Roost, the same pattern.
